purpose: Calibrate a declared small physical yaw perturbation on the current Stage4 roller-assisted body. This is a body-only screen, not olfactory feedback or Stage4/5 admission.

rivals.A: Pure world-z torque on thorax via mj_applyFT added to existing prosthesis force; physical perturbation with unchanged neural command replay.
rivals.B: Direct root yaw generalized torque qfrc[5], equivalent to A only if the restored model maps a thorax pure torque to that sole DOF; measure the map before use.
rivals.C: Rigid olfactory frame rotation without body force, useful as an input control if physical support or torque map fails; cannot be labelled wind or body perturbation.

legal_information: Saved body/controller state and command trace, MuJoCo model inertia and documented unit conversion, all exposed before this preflight. No neural output from a new perturbation is available.

model.formula: torque_Nm = - M_native[5,5] * torque_Nm_per_native * radians(1) / (pulse_duration_s * (total_s - pulse_start_s - pulse_duration_s/2)); M measured in a scratch MjData from prepared state. This free-body estimate is a fixed initial pulse, not a predicted MuJoCo outcome.
model.pulse_shapes: identical physical torque_Nm over the same [50,70) ms wall-physical interval at both step sizes
model.command_policy: Replay the same 200 signed forward/yaw commands from strict reference plus; keep motorized contact controller intact. Zero arm uses the same commands.

stop: Stop after failed baseline replay, out-of-domain body state, time/memory limit, three arms, or source mismatch. Preserve failures and do not retune the pulse based on the new yaw.
